page.running_head: De Morte & statu hominis post eam.

main_text.p: tim Scholasticis, omnem operam huc conferentibus, obtinuit tandem superstitio & idololatria; quæ superiori quoque sæculo à Tridentino Concilio roborata est. Quæ quum divinum honorem præcipue lædat, primumque Decalogi præceptum impetat, alio loco examinanda & confutanda erit. Sufficit hoc loco monere, præstare qualibuscunque illis circa mortuos officiis abstinere, & non nimis affectui indulgere; istudque precum ac officiorum commercium, omnemque Sanctorum communionem, juxta Scripturam, non cum fato functis, sed cum viventibus exercere; cum mortui partem inter viventes non amplius habeant, & alterius Ecclesiæ cives facti sint.
main_text.notes: Woodcut ornament below the text, not transcribed. Page 293 running head at top is set in small capitals.

page.notes: Show-through and faint marks on the page were ignored. Some words in the first line are partly obscured by ink spread and are read as printed; "superstitio" and "idololatria" are as printed.
